newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Jan monetary base, debt data due this week.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Jan monetary base, debt data due this week.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank expects to release monetary base, debt and deficit data for January on Thursday or Friday this week, a spokesman said.
The bank was also expected to announce final public sector deficit figures for 1996.
"The numbers should come out Thursday or Friday," the spokesman said.

Altamir Lopes, head of the bank's economics department, has confirmed market predictions of a 1996 operational deficit of 4.5 percent of gross domestic product, just slightly down on 1995's 5.0 percent of GDP deficit.

On Monday, Central Bank International Affairs Director Gustavo Franco said at a seminar in Rio de Janeiro that the nominal consolidated public sector deficit, which represents the Public Sector Borrowing Requirement, stood at 7.0 percent of GDP.
